method: Read all authoritative jobs and bank schema/rubric. Replaced repeated generic prompt with subject-specific natural Arabic questions and precise accepted aliases. Actually opened primary institutional/manufacturer pages for the 13 requested uncommon identities. This is source/editorial review only; the tilepuzzle lead owns actual asset and jumble-renderer review.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: The zoo describes a mammal covered in overlapping keratin scales, a small pointed head and long scaled tail. It explicitly distinguishes pangolins from true anteaters despite the common name scaly anteater.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: Reference is a tree pangolin; use for generic pangolin recognition only. Do not infer exact species from generated image. آكل النمل alone and مدرع are not equivalent aliases.

openedPrimaryReferences.publisher: University of Wisconsin–Madison Division of Extension
openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: Romanesco has light green heads composed of cone-shaped florets in repeated spiral arrangements. The article lists Romanesco broccoli and Roman cauliflower as common names and identifies it as a Brassica oleracea cultivar.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: Do not assert that it is a broccoli–cauliflower hybrid. Generic broccoli/cauliflower alone would be too broad; qualified Romanesco aliases are fair.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: The museum catalogues Master View-Graph, circa 1960, specifically as an overhead projector, with an object image and aluminium/glass materials.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: Catalogue supports the object class, not every geometric detail in an unseen generated asset. The draft's raised arm/lit base comes from the authoritative generation job. No digital projector or document camera equivalence is claimed.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: The manufacturer explains that lift fans pressurize the space between hull, ground and flexible skirt; pressure raises the craft and thrust propellers move it over surfaces including water and sand.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: Generic air-cushion-vehicle identity only. No exact model, fan count or dimensions claimed. مروحية is not an alias.

openedPrimaryReferences.publisher: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism
openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: Official Arabic guide page 3 (zero-based PDF page 2) identifies traditional wind towers as البراجيل and states they direct cool air into houses; it also uses برج رياح for a traditional Emirati house.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: Text was opened/read; attempted screenshot could not render. Supports Arabic naming and ventilation function, not exact four-sided geometric layout. بادكير/بادغير are editorial regional transliterations, not terms verified in this Arabic guide.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: Columnar jointing forms roughly prismatic parallel columns as cooling volcanic material contracts and fractures. Most columns are hexagonal, but three to seven sides occur; basalt is common but other volcanic rocks can also form columns.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: Do not require every polygon to have six sides. Appearance alone cannot prove basalt composition; the planned scene specifies basalt. No identification of a particular real-world site.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: Under Handpan, the manufacturer describes two joined hemispherical metal segments, a central field, surrounding fields on the upper side and a lower opening. Its Steel Tongue Drum entry separately describes cut-out tongues.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: The English page mistranslates tone field as clay field; no claim of clay material is taken. Only steel construction/layout distinction used, not unrelated healing claims elsewhere on the page. Handpan is not a tongue drum.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: The creator's history distinguishes its Hang instrument/name from later instruments and states that the Hang name was protected to avoid its becoming a generic name. Describes hand-played metal sound sculptures and tone-field development.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: Used only to avoid equating a generic unbranded handpan with the specific Hang name. No legal conclusion or manufacturer identification of the planned asset. هانغ درام removed as an imprecise generic alias.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: The museum labels its brass circular instrument Astrolabe and describes its mater, plates, rete, degree/zodiac/calendar scales and alidade.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: Supports the generic layered circular astronomical instrument and rete terminology; exact engraving, epoch, cultural origin and working calibration cannot be inferred from a generated visual. Not a sextant.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: The museum catalogues Panpipes made from cane or bamboo bound with twine, with seven pipes ranging from 11.2 to 5.7 cm, classified as a blow-hole aerophone.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: Supports bundles of differing-length pipes. No requirement that a generic image reproduce this American historical example or exactly seven pipes.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: Yamaha describes a marimba as struck wooden tone bars with resonator tubes suspended below; bar layout resembles a piano keyboard and tube lengths vary with pitch.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: General marimba anatomy only, not exact tuning/note count. A small toy xylophone or metal-bar vibraphone is not automatically equivalent. Peer must still check the actual image.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: The geyser explanation describes constrictions that allow steam pressure to build, then force water upward in an eruption; hot springs and geysers are separately mentioned.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: Generic erupting geothermal water feature only, not identification as Giantess or another named geyser. Plain ينبوع حار includes non-erupting springs; removed. سخان أرضي is an unclear alias; removed.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: The salt-flats page describes evaporated salts in an enclosed dry basin, a salt crust, crystal growth through mudcracks and fresh white salt after rain.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: No named location or exact mineral composition required. سبخة ملحية retained as a common Arabic recognition alias, not a claim that all salt flats are coastal sabkhas.

openedPrimaryReferences.evidence: The zoo identifies axolotl as an aquatic salamander retaining conspicuous external feathery gills, a tail and body fin; lizard-like limbs and several pale/pink forms are described.
openedPrimaryReferences.limits: Identification only. Not a fish, lizard or frog; neither exact morph nor medical/regeneration claims included.
